claim: M705 rpm-window occupancy C1 [1850,2150), C1b <1500 outside ramps, C2 [4300,4500); ratio of sums, day-clustered percentile bootstrap

reproduced.note: C1 fast/all/thr400 shown (208 drives w/ engine-on, 44 days); full grid of 7488 cell values in audit/m705_blind_out.json

C1.ci_0.5pp: PASS windows (max 0.40pp); zone sub-cells FAIL 5/88 estimable (0.63-3.85pp, thin days)

C2.any_occupancy: PASS 8/41 fast/slow (thr400,300) for 4300-4500; 10/49 for 4200-4600; all-cohort total 49/59

spot_check: 40 random drives x thr{300,400} x r{0,3,5,10} x 5 windows x 8 zones vs rpm_window_cache npz: 0 mismatches (1600 window checks plus totals)
mismatch_cause: interval breaches are Monte Carlo noise of my independent RNG on heavy-tailed thin cells: same cell re-bootstrapped with seeds 1,2,3 (B=4000) gives upper limits 83.45, 83.02 (B=40000: 83.78) vs author 81.73. No grid, ffill, ramp or zone-assignment difference found.
method_concerns: Interval MC error is up to ~1.5-4pp in cells with <40 days and wide skew; B=4000 seed 42 is not enough to make 0.5pp tolerance meaningful there; state MC error or report as descriptive
Hundreds of unadjusted CIs (2 strata x 4 cohorts x 2 thr x windows/zones/ramps); no multiplicity control; keep fixed order, no highlighting, no inference from single cells
Same seed reused for every cell (correlated draws, benign) and draws with zero denominator silently dropped (draws field reports it)
cohort falls back to 'warm' via coh.get(file,'warm') if thermal_regime missing (hidden default; currently 0 affected since all clean drives are mapped)
reconciliation vs sidecar grid: only 223/651 drives equal, max diff 92 s; disclosed as not a gate, but two grids coexist in the repo
cadence-regime NaN drives (12) are outside the 651 clean set; no strata contrast drawn
language_concerns: C1b: share <1500 is 8.5% but <1475 is 0.3% and <1525 is 16%: the result is boundary-fragile (quantisation/rounding around 1500 rpm), so no wording like 'engine does not run below 1500' being confirmed or contradicted
Occupancy is of app-logged, 1 s resampled rpm (mean, 3 s carry), not measured engine speed; describe as logged
Manufacturer points are quoted EU-market figures; do not label consistent/inconsistent, no margin (spec states this)
Cold and thin zone cells below 10 drives/5 days are correctly not estimated; keep status text, do not paraphrase as no occupancy
verdict_note: point estimates and per-drive seconds reproduce exactly; only interval endpoints in 11 thin cells exceed the 0.5pp tolerance, attributable to bootstrap MC noise, not definitions. Add MC-error caveat.
